cells.gaps: No credible statistic found since October 2023 gives graduate unemployment of 14 per cent or less.
cells.note: Restaged 2026-11-09 on Bill's ruling (message 94): question 4 asks for graduate unemployment from any credible statistic, not youth unemployment. The latest figure, 3.39 per cent of employment for 2024, clears 1; Statistics Mauritius's 18.4 per cent for 2025 counts all young people, not graduates.
